note: Which vanilla component checks a React spec now carries. Curated, and checked by scripts/audit_check_port.py: the counts are re-read from the suites on every run, and every named test must exist in the named spec. The vanilla suites stay the regression net until R6.

tests: marks a conversational reply as having read no source and shows no fact table
shows the first reading and the stages while a turn works, and stops on request
returns the question to the box and states the server message when a turn fails
unfolds more of the evidence in the full register, and remembers the choice
falls back to the conversational register when the stored value is unreadable
renders a retrieved answer with its value, its source and its window
sets a held answer apart from a retrieved one
states the language downgrade in words rather than passing as answered
draws an uncovered part of the window as a gap and says so
renders the rail from the registry and lands on Ask for its own route
keeps the keyboard shortcut contract the rail prints
honours a deep link instead of overriding it
opens the command palette from the keyboard and names every surface
offers only the languages whose writing this project measured, sorted by name
does not treat a written language as speakable unless speech was verified
states the store state it read, and never a blank chip
shows an unreachable store as unreachable
offers every known language, marked where this project has not measured its writing
writes the fields into the editable question box, moves focus there, and sends nothing
renders the station rows with their distances, ages and staleness, the district line and the hour units
renders the national counts, the stated tally, the evidence and its own limits
renders only the colours the payload stated, beside the product wording, and says what it filters
renders the index counts, states an unprinted issue date and a pruned body honestly
renders the capability and source counts, each provider’s own availability, and the local state
draws only the colours the features stated, and lists the same features in the table
draws the layer the reader chooses, and states when no feature carried a colour
prints both printed editions with their vintages, invents no delta, and reads the district product
renders the directory rows it was given, reads the selected state, and filters only the rows already read
asks for a district and does not read a brief from a coordinate when none is named
renders the modelled parameters with their units, the cell and its distance, and says it is a model
records a cell distance the payload does not state as absent, never as a number computed here
renders the station rows and decoded values the METAR read returned, with each own instant, age and freshness
reads a report the source marks stale as stale, and never restyles another word as current
renders the counts and rows the index stated, offers only those districts, and reads the series for one
states a year with no row, and a row holding no value, as absent rather than as a zero
renders each read with its own cell, the distance the payload states, model and unit, and states the boundary
renders the member counts the read returned, the spread it stated, and its own limits
renders the window, sources, per-lead counts and metrics, and leaves an unmeasured lead unmeasured
draws only returned values, leaves a missing point as a gap, and keeps the table alongside
says so when every point is missing rather than drawing an empty frame
says so when the series came back with no points at all
